input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet with columns sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,treatment.

fasta.description: Path to viral reference FASTA file.

gff.description: Path to annotation GFF3 file containing CDS features.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier used in reporting outputs.

publish_dir_mode.description: Mode for publishing files to output directory (copy, symlink, link).

viral_contig.description: Target viral contig identifier in BAM files.

protocol.description: Sequencing protocol. 'amplicon' enables iVar primer trimming.

primer_bed.description: Primer BED file. Required when --protocol amplicon.

ivar_min_depth.description: Minimum coverage depth threshold to examine positions for iVar variant calling.

ivar_min_freq.description: Minimum allele frequency to report, as a proportion (0–1). Values < 0.005 require median depth ≥ 10,000× to be statistically meaningful.

ivar_min_mq.description: Minimum mapping quality for iVar's mpileup. Must match lofreq_min_mq, otherwise iVar and LoFreq are given different reads and their call sets are not comparable.

ivar_consensus_min_cov.description: Minimum coverage depth for consensus calling in iVar.

ivar_consensus_threshold.description: Allele frequency threshold for consensus nucleotide insertion.

lofreq_min_depth.description: Minimum coverage depth threshold for LoFreq calling.

lofreq_sig.description: Significance threshold for LoFreq variant call.

lofreq_enable_indelqual.description: Enable indel quality assessment in LoFreq.

lofreq_enable_baq.description: Enable base alignment quality calculation in LoFreq.

lofreq_sb_thresh.description: Fixed strand-bias phred cutoff passed to lofreq filter as --sb-thresh, used in place of LoFreq's built-in FDR rule. 0 (the default) keeps the built-in rule. Either rule also requires about 85% of the alt reads to sit on one strand before it drops a call.

lofreq_max_depth.description: Depth at which LoFreq stops counting reads (--max-depth). Above it a call's VAF comes from the first reads LoFreq meets, not from all of them, and can differ from the full-depth value. 1000000 is LoFreq's own default. Raise it for libraries deeper than that.

viloca_window.description: Window size for VILOCA/ShoRAH local quasispecies reconstruction.

viloca_shift.description: Window shift step size for VILOCA/ShoRAH local quasispecies reconstruction.

cliquesnv_min_freq.description: Minimum allele frequency threshold for CliqueSNV quasispecies reconstruction.

haplotype_report_min_freq.description: Minimum frequency threshold (as a proportion 0–1) for reporting confirmed quasispecies haplotypes.

viloca_min_pair_samples.description: Minimum sample threshold for classifying recurrent linked mutation pairs in VILOCA.

viloca_min_pair_support.description: Minimum posterior support threshold for VILOCA linked mutation pair reporting.

viloca_min_reads.description: Minimum read count threshold for VILOCA linked mutation pair reporting.

run_ivar.description: Enable iVar variant and consensus subworkflow.

run_ivar_consensus.description: Also run iVar consensus calling when run_ivar is true. It is a second full pileup of the same BAM and nothing downstream reads it. At full depth it costs as much time and memory as the iVar variant pass, so switch it off there.

run_annotation.description: Enable functional annotation via bcftools csq.

run_coverage.description: Enable coverage depth summary and QC.

run_haplotype.description: Enable CliqueSNV and VILOCA haplotype reconstruction.

stock_reference_options.title: Stock reference options
stock_reference_options.description: Build a per-stock reference from a de novo consensus (-entry BUILD_STOCK_REFERENCE).

stock_consensus.description: De novo consensus FASTA for one virus stock. Must hold a single contig.

stock_name.description: Name given to the stock contig, and the CHROM of every variant called against it. Defaults to the consensus file name.

stock_primer_bed.description: Primer scheme in lab-reference coordinates (BED6). Moved onto the stock, because ivar trim needs the coordinates of whatever the reads were aligned to.

liftover_tsv.description: Liftover table from BUILD_STOCK_REFERENCE (qc/<stock>.liftover.tsv). When set, the annotated VCFs and the variant summary table gain lab-reference coordinates (REF_CONTIG, REF_POS, REF_END, REF_STATUS).
